mapper.select:
select a.id as taskId, a.name as taskName, c.id as skuId, c.name as skuName, c.sku_no as skuNo, a.phase_name as phaseName, a.phase_id as phaseId, b.is_finish_task as isFinishTask, a.status from project_task a inner join project_task_ref_sku b on a.id = b.task_id AND b.is_deleted = FALSE inner join product_detail c on b.sku_id = c.id AND c.is_deleted = FALSE WHERE a.is_deleted = FALSE
and a.product_id = #{productId}
